title: Chapter 627
paragraphs: Chapter 627
Episode 161. Return (4)
"Beast King Orgal..."
Jin glared at the blurred scenery beyond the iron door.
Instead of Orgal's figure, the distorted form of space was seen.

[I didn't expect you to suddenly appear in the desert after disappearing 2 years and 6 months ago. Seems like the hiding place of the great demonic tribe your god saved must have been hidden somewhere here. As soon as you came back, you drove my loyal subordinate to the brink of death...]
"If you don't like it, why don't you come out through that door right now? Thanks to him, I've warmed up a bit."
[You've become too strong to kill now. And I don't have a reason to.]
As Kinzelo, there's no reason to kill Jin.
Because there is no better card than Jin when it comes to keeping Runcandel and Zipfel in check.
Through Orgal's answer, Jin could infer that the balance and tension among the giant powers were still being maintained.
"You guys are bound to get wiped out while trying to keep other powers in check through me."
[Considering your actions so far, that could certainly happen. But don't worry, we're preparing on our end as well.]
"Didn't it sound more like a warning than a concern?"
[If so, it's a scary thing.]

"I don't know whether it's confidence, or you had no choice but to save that demon guy. But you made a mistake again. You revealed to me that you haven't fully recovered yet. You better hope that the life of that guy Lanke was worth it."
A moment of silence followed.
Feeling like there was no more value in further conversation, Jin was the first to turn his back.
Watching Jin's back, Orgal added one last thing.
[There are many mountains you have to cross before you meet me. I also hope you don't die in there.]
As Jin disappeared beyond the wind of chaos, the leader immediately opened a new iron door to the old headquarters of Kinzelo.
Right to the place where Ainas and Bubare were bickering while Lanke was getting beaten up.
"It's the leader!"
"Eh, leader!? What's going on all of a sudden?"
[Lanke was beaten by Jin.]
"Eh? Lanke? Was Jin Runcandel there!?"
"Lanke was beaten? By him!?"
"Is Lanke dead?"
[Fortunately, he was saved. Quickly collect the important documents left at the headquarters. And how many completed masters are there?]
"Five. No, was it four?"

[No matter how many there are, make sure only those and you guys pass through the iron door. Issue evacuation orders to the remaining members to their assigned branches. As of this time, the old headquarters is to be closed down.]
"I don't know how he managed to defeat Lanke. If he fought with Lanke, he must be tired. We should take him down now."
[Jin isn't tired, and the blow would be too big. Get ready quickly.]
Ainas and Bubare hurriedly gathered documents. The four completed masters also crossed through the iron door.
While they were leaving, Jin started to destroy all the contaminated areas in the land of the beastmen that he came across as he left the Mitra desert. For a full twelve hours.
In the process, the contaminated beastmen area outside the Mitra desert was completely turned to ashes, and the old headquarters of Kinzelo hidden deep underground was completely reduced to dust.
The Vamel Federation, Tikan Free Nation.
Kashmir and Jin's comrades were receiving a report from the Chilseokjo. It was a report on the massive destruction that took place in the contaminated beastman area and Kinzelo's old headquarters.

There had been frequent small and large battles among the various powers in the beastman area where Kinzelo's old headquarters were located. Until about a year ago, all the powers agreed to use it as a waste disposal site.
However, those who knew the inside story of these battles essentially assessed Kinzelo as the ultimate victor of the fight.

Despite using it as a common waste disposal site, the management of the desert was solely entrusted to Lanke, a demon from Kinzelo. Neither Zipfel nor Runcandel were able to station people in the desert.
Therefore, after the desert was under the control of Lanke, Tikan had made relentless efforts to confirm what Kinzelo was doing there.
Naturally, it was for Jin.
If Jin were to encounter Lanke and Kinzelo's powerful men as soon as he came out of Lafrarosa, they predicted that there could be significant problems with his return.
Furthermore, there were many concerns about why the various powers had fought so many unofficial battles in the desert, even violating the truce agreement.
If the major powers somehow found out that Jin was in Lafrarosa and therefore were waiting for him to return and eliminate him.
Tikan also had to be prepared.
Of course, Runcandel's reason for sticking to the desert could have been different from that of Zipfel and Kinzelo.
From the beginning, as soon as Jin left for training, articles related to it were first spread by Runcandel.
That Runcandel's next heir had left for his final training.
Therefore, Runcandel's reason for securing the desert would have been for Jin's safety, unlike the remaining two powers.
But recently, the atmosphere of Runcandel that Tikan had sensed was not normal.
It was even judged that perhaps even Runcandel was trying to secure the desert to eliminate Jin.
The agents of Chilseokjo only figured out that there was a problem in the beastmen area, but they didn't know exactly what kind of battle took place.
"Considering the large amount of brain energy detected... it could be Master Jin, right? Kashmir."
Valkas said.
"That would be ideal. However, the energy was powerful enough to completely obliterate the Beastmen region. It's more likely a battle between groups rather than an individual."
Upon hearing Kashmir's frustrated reply, Valkas and Gilly sighed.
Three years, even if Jin had reached 10 stars in that time, it was hard to imagine that he could single-handedly devastate the entire Beastmen region.
Moreover, Lanke was there. The demon who consistently exhibited overwhelming strength in numerous battles against Runcandel and Zipfel in the desert.
Tikan had confirmed that he had also won against the Black Knights and the Specter Troops.
"Besides, if both the Beastmen region and the old headquarters are completely destroyed... this battle signifies Kinzelo's defeat. The rights to the desert will go to the victor."
Runcandel, Zipfel.
Either of them taking over the desert was problematic, more so than Kinzelo. Unlike Kinzelo, there would be absolutely no room for negotiation.
"Phew, if they have confirmed the existence of Raprarosa... we'll have to find out how they did it."
"The worst-case scenario is if Master Jin was attacked as soon as he left Raprarosa. We won't know for sure just by discussing here, so we have no choice but to go and check ourselves."
The atmosphere in the meeting room became heavy.
Currently, Tikan was severely short-staffed.
Thanks to Kwall's abilities, they had managed to fully fortify, but Murakan was still acting as Solderet's substitute, and Misha was still sealing Elona.
The biggest problem was Gwigok Saseong. Except for Valkas, all of Tikan's powerful members were on standby near Gwigok Saseong.
They couldn't ask Bi Gung and Mung for help either.
The internal injuries Talaris sustained from the Sword Emperor's temple didn't heal, just like with Ron, and Yona, who had visited Tikan frequently after Jin left, hadn't been in touch for a while.
And Tikan couldn't rule out the possibility that Yona was going on a rampage in chaos.
"It's too dangerous for Sir Valkas alone. I will seek help from the family and Hairan."
"Runcandel is out of the question, Gilly. It's too risky. It would be best to only visit Hairan."
"Your Majesty!"
Someone rushed in, calling out desperately.
It was Jet. His colleagues could breathe a sigh of relief upon seeing Jet's excited expression and Jin standing behind him.
"Master Jin!"
"Lord...!"
"My Lord...!"
"Haha, our master, our master has finally returned!"
Gilly was the first to run and hug Jin.
Jin comforted her for a while and smiled at her.
"I'm back, Gilly."
"Master, I'm so glad you're back safely...! But what about these injuries."
The signs of battle were evident all over Jin's body.
"Ah, as soon as I left Lafrarosa, a guy named Lanke attacked. I couldn't kill him because I was busy saving Orgal."
At that moment, the others were shocked beyond their previous concerns.
"La, Lanke Halobiche? Then, did you... single-handedly caused such devastation in the Beastmen region!?"
While examining Jin's body, Gilly noticed that all the black spots of chaos had disappeared. She also realized that he had become much stronger compared to before.
"It seems we were worrying for nothing, Kashmir."
"Indeed... Master Jin, what kind of training have you undergone these past 3 years? Anyway, I'm glad you're back safely!"
"There are many things to talk about and to hear. But first, I think we need to go to Gwigok Saseong."
On his way to the meeting room, Jin had heard about Gwigok Saseong from Jet.
Smariyon Proch. The father of Lata and Fey, and the previous leader of the Ghost Troop, known as the strongest in its history.
The reason why Tikan's strongest people were on standby near Gwigok Saseong was because his seal was on the verge of breaking.
"We'll talk on the way. As Sir Kashmir cannot leave his post, only Gilly, Sir Valkas and I will go."
"What, Jin Runcandel? Did you just get back?"
Kwall also entered the meeting room. He had come to inform Kashmir about the research situation without knowing that Jin had returned.
He looked even more gaunt than before, perhaps due to the tough research he had been conducting.
"I hope you haven't been smoking five cigarettes at once where the kids are, Mr. Kwall."
"Hmph, no matter how tough I am, I don't do such things. It seems like you've got some stuff from the Demon King's tribe."
"Please analyze it while I'm visiting Gwigok Saseong. I've also brought blueprints that you'll find exciting, Mr. Kwall. I will hear about the past research when I return."
"Ah, understood. It's a good timing, I have a completed airship from a month ago. Ride that. Its performance will surprise you. It'll be the answer to the research, too."
